review_evidence: README identifies this as a large Rocq/Coq category-theory development whose primary aim is representation and manipulation of categorical terms and their realization in target categories.
The repository contains 981 .v primary files; a declaration scan found major Definition/Lemma/Theorem/Proposition/Corollary/Class/Record/Inductive/Fixpoint forms in 868 files.

README and source-tree inspection cover core category theory, adjunctions, monads/comonads, (co)limits, profunctors and Day convolution, displayed/Grothendieck constructions, additive/abelian structure, bicategories and double categories, enrichment, adjoint functor theorems, Lawvere theories, operads, and topos theory.
Probe, issue-regression, Examples, and Test .v files were deliberately retained because they are formal Rocq terms/proofs and can supply useful usage and regression evidence under the corpus policy.
summary: Retain the complete Rocq category-theory development, including formal probes/tests/examples; no repository-local exclusion is losslessly justified.

review_evidence: Adjunction/Continuity/Equalizer.v: Defines right_adjoint_PreservesEqualizers and not_PreservesEqualizers_no_left_adjoint with full proofs and universe annotations

Instance/Ab/Character.v: Constructs Pontryagin dual Q/Z, character functor D, double dual DD, and natural evaluation tau (Mac Lane I.4)
Instance/Fun/Action/Monad.v: Group-action monad G×(−), free/forgetful adjunction, algebras=actions, two monadicity proofs (Beck + explicit quasi-inverse)
Instance/Grp/Limit.v: Grp_Forget strictly creates all limits; Grp complete; limits computed coordinatewise on underlying sets at eq_refl
Instance/Mod/BaseChange.v: Base change ℤ→R adjunction ZExt ⊣ RMod_Forget_Ab with unit/counit at eq_refl, no commutativity hypothesis
Instance/Mod/Limit.v: RMod_Forget_Ab strictly creates limits via mediator-in-Ab technique; RMod_Complete from Ab_Complete
Instance/Pos/Monadicity.v: Discrete poset adjunction over PropSets (identity monad) and Sets (truncation monad); Pos_Forget not monadic (Awodey §10.3)
Instance/Proset/Monad.v: Monads on preorders = closure operators; algebras = closed elements; Eilenberg-Moore = closed elements via Idempotent.v
Instance/Top/Circle.v: Constructive Cauchy reals circle R/Z with quotient topology in Top and PTopCat; wrapping maps; PropEquiv via rounding
Instance/Top/CompHaus.v: Compact Hausdorff spaces; bijection theorem with decidability condition; truncated product topology attempt; conditional creation
Monad/Eilenberg/Moore/Limit.v: EM_Forget strictly creates limits for any monad (Mac Lane VI.2 Exercise 2); EM_Complete corollary
